projectTitle: Turbo Luxury car-care planners and estimators
description: Small dependency-light libraries (JavaScript, Python, PHP, Rust, Dart, C#, Ruby) and agent skills for car owners in hot, dusty climates: wash package and interval planner, wax/sealant/ceramic chooser with renewal dates, detailing job planner, cabin heat, water-per-wash and stain first-aid estimators, and a WhatsApp booking-message builder.
rules: Package prices are AED ranges from the public price list: Quick Shine 60-70, Golden Shine 100-120, Diamond Shine 150-170, Detailing Shine 300; the planners give estimates, not quotes or bookings.

washIntervalDays starts at 7 (outdoor), 10 (covered) or 14 (garage) days, subtracts 1 for mixed or 3 for desert driving, and clamps the result to 4-21 days; recommend picks the lowest package tier that covers every trigger in the car profile.

Paint protection durability is wax 1-2 months, sealant 3-6 months and ceramic coating 12-24 months; due_date and reminder_dates use the minimum months when harsh=True (all-day outdoor parking) and the rounded midpoint otherwise.
